title: Nanohexagonal iron barium titanate nanoparticles surface-modified NiFe2O4 composite screen-printed electrode for enzymatic glucose monitoring
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34948-34963
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06689H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hend S. Magar, Amany M. El Nahrawy, Rabeay Y. A. Hassan, Ali B. Abou Hammad
Nanocomposites of iron barium titanate/NiFe2O4 (FBT/NF) were fabricated and used as nanostructure-based electrochemical biosensors for glucose detection in human blood samples with high precision compared to reference methods.
